title: Capo re-origins the fret numbers
description: Capo 2 on default (undeclared) standard tuning; four bare quarters sound F#2 B2 E3 A3 — each exactly an effective open string (open + 2 semitones), so every derived fret is 0 on strings 6 5 4 3. Proves both capo jobs at once: the open pitches shift up, and printed frets are counted from the capo. Also exercises the absent-strings[] default composing with a declared capo.
